new_task_1.title: Update flask run startup banner to always warn about the development server
new_task_1.description: The `flask run` startup banner has been simplified. Instead of printing an environment line and only warning in the `production` environment, Flask 2.2.0 now always prints a prominent red warning that the built-in server is for development only. The app banner also no longer shows a `(lazy loading)` suffix and formats the import path as `* Serving Flask app 'module'` when available.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that the startup banner shown by `flask run` consistently warns users that the built-in server is only for development use, regardless of environment mode. Ensure that obsolete banner details tied to environment reporting and lazy-loading state are no longer displayed.

expectation.grounded: When `show_server_banner` runs outside the reloader process, it must emit a red, bold warning stating that this is a development server and should not be used in production, followed by guidance to use a production WSGI server instead. If an application import path is known, it must print `* Serving Flask app '...'` without any `(lazy loading)` suffix. The banner must no longer print a `* Environment: ...` line. The existing `* Debug mode: on/off` line must still be shown when a debug value is provided.
expectation.conceptual: Starting the development server should always surface the same production-safety warning, rather than conditioning it on an environment label. The startup banner should be shorter and focused on the app being served and whether debug mode is enabled.

constraints.grounded: The banner must still be suppressed when running from the reloader child process so messages are not duplicated. The change must only affect startup text output; server startup behavior, debug mode selection, and app loading semantics must remain unchanged. If no app import path is available, the serving-app line must be omitted rather than replaced with placeholder text.
constraints.conceptual: This is a presentation change to the Flask CLI banner, not a change to how the server loads or serves the application. Existing startup flow must remain intact apart from the revised user-facing messages.

behavior: Starting `flask run` outside the reloader always prints a prominent warning that the built-in server is for development only.
The startup banner no longer includes an `Environment:` line.
The startup banner no longer includes a `(lazy loading)` suffix in the serving-app message.
When an app import path is available, the banner prints `* Serving Flask app 'module'` using single quotes around the import path.
The debug mode line continues to be shown when a debug state is available.
acceptance_criteria: When `flask run` starts outside the reloader in either development or production-style configuration, the terminal output includes the development-server warning.
When `flask run` starts, the terminal output does not include a line beginning with `* Environment:`.
When Flask knows the application import path, the banner includes `* Serving Flask app '...'` and does not append `(lazy loading)`.
When debug mode is enabled or disabled explicitly, the banner still shows `* Debug mode: on` or `* Debug mode: off`.
When the reloader child process starts, the banner is not printed a second time.
